facts.fact: The DGDDI announced the e-DIEBS platform, attached to Sydonia World for centralised handling of import and export declarations, to start on 30 March 2026 with the Libreville customs region as pilot site and a three-month transitional period, other regional directorates to be integrated progressively.

systems.owner: Direction Generale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI)
